visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a grey medical professional uniform, sits in a bright clinical office. She gestures towards her elbow with her right hand, demonstrating skin texture. Behind her is a white shelf with awards and a YouTube play button. (2) Visual overlays appear on the right side of the frame, showing close-up circular images of darkened, thickened skin on an elbow and then on a pair of knees. The woman continues talking, pointing at her own elbow to provide context for the skin condition. (3) The camera zooms in slightly as the woman holds up a white and orange cardboard box for a 20% urea cream product. She uses her fingers to point at the label and then shows a silver-lidded jar inside. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product packaging details and her professional appearance. (4) A close-up shot shows her hands applying a thick, white ointment from the jar onto her elbow skin. She rubs the cream in circular motions. The background remains the clinic setting, with soft lighting emphasizing the texture of the cream on her skin. (5) The video transitions to a white graphic background featuring the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo in dark grey. Contact information, including a LINE ID, phone number, and two physical address locations in Taiwan, is displayed in clean, centered text boxes.
